prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one bespoke illustration for one of four Kariri Valley website cards about the innovation community in Cariri, Ceará, Brazil. Style: richly textured handmade editorial paper collage, watercolor and engraved cut-paper shapes, irregular torn edges, tactile warm paper, botanical foliage, a small mustard-yellow sun disk and low blue-green Chapada do Araripe silhouette. Cohesive restrained palette: forest green #1E4D3A, cream #F4EEE1, mustard #E9B23C, terracotta #C25A2E, turquoise #239D8C. Contemporary Brazilian Northeast, people and territory, dignified and optimistic. Landscape composition 3:2, compact complete vignette centered with a little clear space around outermost shapes, sufficiently bold to read at 240px wide. Genuinely transparent background outside the collage. No rectangular backdrop, no text, letters, labels, logos, watermarks, photo-real portrait, neon, glossy 3D, generic corporate stock graphics. No fabricated identifiable real person. Subject: Public sector connecting and supporting the territory. A modest cream municipal civic building with terracotta roof and green arched doors, not a grand European palace, with two civic workers and a community representative studying a simple map of Cariri on a wooden table in the foreground. One discreet warm-paper path with short terracotta dashed marks connects the building, people and the landscape. Communicate local coordination and public support for innovation, not party politics; no flags or party insignia.
